# dsh-activity-bar
Turn the space freed by DSH's collapsed side panels into narrow icon rails, VS Code style — and give
the width back to your workspace.
中文 · English
## What it does
DSH keeps its left sidebar and right bar open by default; together they eat close to 40% of the wind
ow width. With this plugin installed:
- **Two 44px rails** — one on each side, always there. Entries come from the host registry, so the r

ails grow and shrink with the plugins you install
- **Room that is really given up** — a rail never
sits on top of a panel: the whole grid steps 44px inwards, so column widths, dragging and animation

stay the host's own
- **Nothing disappears** — the action row the sidebar used to pin to its bottom
(DS Bot, memory, settings, account, plus the 远程 launcher other plugins drop in) becomes a strip alon

g the bottom of the rail: icons only, each one centred
- **A drag-resizable right panel** — grab the
handle on the panel's left edge; the width is clamped to 300px … 60% of the window and remembered a

cross restarts
- **Either side can be switched off** — Settings → **Activity Bar**, two switches, ef
fective immediately; an off side goes back to stock DSH
## Requirements
DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` or newer (Node `>= 22.13`).
## Install
From git, one command:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh` lives at `<DeepSeek Harness>/resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`; point `--profile` at the prof
ile you want it in. The command writes the dependency into that profile and registers the package in
`dsh.profile.bundles` for you.
Then **restart DSH** — plugins are mounted at start-up.
